caption:
Can AI-generated books fool Apple Books?

AI-generated knockoffs of Joanna Stern's book keep appearing on Apple Books. Stern called out Apple over the issue in a video published on YouTube Shorts.

The books are generated using AI and mimic the style and content of Stern's original work. Apple has not commented on the issue.

The incident raises concerns about the use of AI-generated content on digital platforms and the need for better moderation and regulation.

#AI #Apple #AppleBooks #FakeBooks
